assertions.name: the live readout reproduces the proved single-crossing bond factor z + d
the deprecated readout does NOT — this is the error behind the retracted test
on all three interface letters the live readout equals z + d and the deprecated one misses by more than 0.1 — the table published as the correction to thm:markov-trace-factorization
S satisfies the Hecke quadratic S^2 = hS + 1 exactly
crossings at a generator commute identically — there is no within-generator non-commutativity for anything to be carried by
the readout is NOT multiplicative within a generator, and the defect is independent of d1, d2
every INTERFACE generator carries exactly one crossing, so no within-generator combination happens on a bond at all

description: Closes qou-jebr negative. The corpus readout is Vhat = z*M[1][0] + M[1][1] with M = alpha + beta*S, S = [[h,1],[1,0]]; pinned against the proved single-crossing bond factor z + d before use, which is the step whose omission caused the earlier retraction (the deprecated readout z*M[0,0] + M[1,0] does not reproduce it). S satisfies S^2 = hS + 1, so every crossing at a generator is a polynomial in the same S and [S+d1, S+d2] = 0 identically: there is NO within-generator non-commutativity and the question is empty. What is true instead is that the readout is not multiplicative within a generator, defect z*h - z^2 + 1 = (q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1)^2, independent of the offsets — a different property, easy to confuse with the first. It still cannot make a quadratic in N-Z: every interface generator carries exactly one crossing, and the multi-crossing generators are intra-nucleon, so their contribution is linear in the counts and never mixes two nucleons.
caveats: Says nothing about the all-pairs word, whose band generators span several generators and genuinely fail to commute — that is qou-bygw, untouched and still blocked on a modelling decision.
Says nothing about whether B = alpha L is a binding energy (qou-qnqf). This settles one narrow question created by testing the wrong object.
